headline: How Power Island Deal Will Impact Baker Hughes (BKR) Investors
summary: Baker Hughes disclosed a new Power Frame Agreement with Venture Global and GE Vernova to supply gas and steam turbines, controls and electrical systems for up to 16 behind the meter power islands supporting US LNG production and potential data center projects, with deliveries scheduled between 2028 and 2034. headline: Should You Sell Your NuScale Power Stock Now?
summary: Investors holding NuScale Power (SMR) stock have faced a punishing year. While the broader S&P 500 returned 17.9%, the shares lost 86.6%. That decline is firmly embedded in the current valuation, regardless of whether you choose to sell or hold. Anyone maintaining a position now owns an enterprise with minimal revenue, waiting on a pending reactor contract in Romania. So what are you actually holding at today's price.
